sections.title: Largo – Gypsy Rhapsody & Passionate Rubato (M. 1–28)
sections.character: Lassú – slow, melancholy gypsy lament with soaring rhapsodic ornaments

sections.title: Allegro vivace – Friss I: Hungarian Folk Fire (M. 29–60)
sections.character: Friss – explosive Hungarian folk dance, crisp staccato and driving syncopations

sections.title: Meno, quasi lento – Cantabile Gypsy Serenade in D Major (M. 61–84)
sections.character: Tender D Major serenade, warm singing tone and romantic expressive swells

sections.title: Allegro – Friss II: Virtuoso Pyrotechnics (M. 85–116)
sections.character: Dazzling rapid articulation, sparkling runs, and exhilarating accelerando

sections.title: Molto più vivo – Coda con fuoco & Prestissimo (M. 117–End)
sections.character: Fiery grand finale, furious Hungarian czardas tempo to a thunderous close

annotations.title: Lassú: Gypsy Rhapsodic Rubato
annotations.instruction: Play with deep emotional freedom. Lean into the poignant diminished chords, linger on expressive high notes, and articulate the violin-inspired arabesques with elastic flexibility.

annotations.title: Friss Ignition: Featherweight Staccatissimo
annotations.instruction: Instant change of character! Spring from the keys with crisp fingertip precision. Keep the left-hand bass and off-beat chords razor-sharp like a cimbalom.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Keep pedal completely dry during fast passagework to preserve rhythmic electricity.

annotations.title: Dolce Cantabile in D Major: Pure Serenade
annotations.instruction: Unfold the golden D Major theme with deep arm weight and warm vocal tone. Balance the rocking accompaniment softly beneath the soaring melodic phrase.

annotations.title: Coda Prestissimo con fuoco: The Ultimate Sprint
annotations.instruction: Build momentum through the accelerando. Do not rush prematurely; allow the rhythmic tension to crest into an electrifying, unstoppable surge to the final fortissimo cadence.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Firm pedal taps on accented downbeats for orchestral impact.
